name: 83-beast-of-barrisdale
description: Beast of Barrisdale: a roaring flying beast, a charcoal-grey body on long thin bent legs with pink hooked claws, a great fan of salmon wings ribbed in red on its back, a pale pink face hung low with a gaping red mouth. Facing left. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing planted on its three clawed feet facing left: it breathes, its fan of wings on its back lifting and beating down twice, its head bobbing, its roaring mouth working. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
